title: How to choose a recruitment agency in Tashkent
description: 10 questions to ask before you sign a contract
body:
There are many recruitment agencies in Tashkent, and at the first meeting almost all of them promise the same thing: fast, high quality, guaranteed. The difference shows later – when a month on you have five random CVs and the position is still open. To avoid this, judge an agency not by its promises but by how it actually works.

The questions below will help you find out before you sign a contract.

First, define the task

Agencies are strong in different areas. Some specialise in mass recruitment for contact centres and retail, others in finding top managers and rare specialists, others in IT. Before the meeting, decide for yourself:

  • how many people you need to hire and by when;
  • the level of the role: frontline staff, specialists or managers;
  • whether you need recruitment only, or also employment of staff (outstaffing) and help with HR processes.

The answer determines which agency will suit you and which questions to ask first.

10 questions to ask an agency

1. In which roles and industries have you filled the most vacancies?

Ask for specific examples similar to your task and for client references with names and company names. A general “we work with all industries” says nothing about results.

2. Who will handle my vacancy?

Find out whether you will have one recruiter in charge, what experience they have and how many vacancies they handle at once. A recruiter with thirty open roles is unlikely to give yours enough attention.

3. Where do you look for candidates?

If the answer is “we post the vacancy on job sites and wait for applications”, you are paying for something you could do yourself. A good agency combines several channels: its own candidate database, direct search, professional communities, Telegram channels and referrals. Executives and rare specialists require direct search, because such people rarely look for a job actively.

4. How do you assess candidates before sending them to me?

Ask who does the initial screening and how: phone pre-screening, competency-based interviews, language checks, test assignments. This decides whether you will spend time interviewing people who clearly do not fit.

5. How many candidates will I see, and when?

Agree on a shortlist: how many candidates the agency will present and by what date. An honest agency will give realistic timelines and explain what they depend on – the market, the requirements and the conditions you offer.

6. What is the guarantee if the hire does not work out?

Find out whether there is a free replacement, how long it is valid and under what conditions. No guarantee at all is a warning sign.

7. How does payment work?

Clarify what exactly you are paying for: the search, the employee's start or the result after probation – and what happens to the prepayment if no suitable candidates are found. All terms should be written into the contract.

8. How do you ensure confidentiality?

This matters most when you are replacing a current employee or opening a new business line. Ask how the agency presents the role to candidates without revealing your company too early, and whether it is ready to sign an NDA.

9. What will you tell candidates about our company?

The agency is your face on the labour market. If a recruiter overstates the conditions, the candidate will be disappointed at the interview or leave in the first month. A good agency agrees with you in advance on how to present the role.

10. What feedback and reporting do you provide?

Besides CVs, it helps to get market insight: how many candidates were considered, why they decline, how well your salary matches specialists' expectations. This helps you adjust the vacancy if the search drags on.

Red flags

  • They promise to fill any vacancy in a couple of days without asking about your company and requirements.
  • They send dozens of CVs without screening or comments.
  • There is no contract or replacement guarantee.
  • They demand full prepayment without any commitments.
  • They cannot name a single client or a similar project.

How to prepare for the first meeting

The more precisely you describe the task, the faster the agency will find the right person. Prepare:

  • the duties and key results you expect from the employee;
  • must-have requirements and nice-to-haves;
  • the salary range and working conditions;
  • the interview stages and who makes the hiring decision;
  • the desired start date.

How we work

Human and Capital is a recruitment agency in Tashkent. We hire specialists and managers, fill mass positions and employ staff under the outstaffing model. Every recruitment project comes with guarantees: one free replacement within the agreed period, a free trial day for the candidate and a refund of the prepayment if we do not present at least three suitable candidates within the agreed timeframe.

title: Mass recruitment in Uzbekistan
description: How to fill dozens of identical vacancies quickly without losing quality
body:
Opening a new contact centre, branch or store means hiring dozens of people for the same roles within a few weeks. Classic recruitment, where each vacancy is handled separately, does not work here: you need a flow of candidates, quick decisions and a clear process. Let's look at how mass recruitment works and where time and people are most often lost.

What mass recruitment is

Mass recruitment means hiring a large number of employees for similar roles in a short time. It is most often needed by:

  • contact centres and BPO projects – operators and support specialists, including those with foreign languages;
  • retail – sales assistants, cashiers, warehouse staff;
  • manufacturing and logistics – workers, drivers, pickers;
  • restaurants and hotels – waiters, cooks, front desk staff.

The main difference from individual recruitment is working with a funnel. What matters is not that every candidate is perfect, but how many people start work on time and stay after probation.

The process step by step

1. Describe the candidate profile

Choose 3–5 must-have criteria: for example, language level, readiness for shift work, clear speech. Everything else is nice to have. The longer the list of must-haves, the narrower the funnel and the longer the search.

2. Calculate the funnel

Work out how many applications you need for one person to start work. For example, if 4 out of 10 applicants come to an interview, 2 get an offer and 1–2 start work, hiring 30 employees will take around 150–300 applications. This is an illustrative example: real numbers depend on the role and the conditions. The calculation immediately shows whether your channels and budget are enough.

3. Use several channels

  • job sites;
  • Telegram channels and job chats for the city and district;
  • referrals from current employees;
  • colleges, universities and language centres – for entry-level roles and language projects;
  • the agency's own candidate database.

Focus on the channels where your audience actually is, and track which of them bring people who start work, not just people who apply.

4. Make applying quick and easy

In mass recruitment candidates apply to several companies at once and choose the one that replies first. A short form instead of a mandatory CV, applying via Telegram and a call within a day noticeably increase the share of people who reach the interview.

5. Run phone pre-screening

A short scripted call checks the must-have criteria: schedule, salary expectations, language level, readiness to start on the required date. This way only people who really fit come to in-person meetings.

6. Use group interviews

Group meetings or assessment days let you evaluate dozens of candidates in a few hours: present the company and the conditions, run short exercises and pick the strongest straight away.

7. Make offers quickly

It is best to share the decision on the day of the interview or the next day. Every day of waiting is a risk that the candidate accepts another offer. A reminder the day before the first working day reduces the number of no-shows.

8. Take care of onboarding

A large share of departures in mass hiring happens in the first weeks. A mentor, a clear training plan and feedback in the first days help you keep the people you worked so hard to find.

Metrics to track

  • Time to fill – how many days pass from opening the vacancy to the employee's start.
  • Stage conversion – where the funnel loses the most candidates.
  • Channel effectiveness – where the people who start and stay come from.
  • Probation pass rate – the main quality metric of mass hiring.

Common mistakes

  • Too many must-have requirements for a frontline role.
  • Slow replies to candidates after they apply or interview.
  • The conditions in the job ad differ from reality – people leave in the first week.
  • No channel tracking, so the budget goes where there are applications but no hires.
  • Onboarding is left “for later”.

Mass recruitment for language projects

For contact centres and BPO projects with foreign languages, a language check – spoken and written – is added to the standard process already at the pre-screening stage. There are fewer such candidates, so direct search, work with language communities and your own database become especially important.

How an agency can help

title: O‘zbekistonda ommaviy xodim tanlash
description: O‘nlab bir xil vakansiyalarni sifatni yo‘qotmasdan qisqa muddatda qanday yopish mumkin
body:
Yangi kontakt-markaz, filial yoki do‘kon ochish – bir necha hafta ichida bir xil lavozimlarga o‘nlab odamni ishga olish demakdir. Har bir vakansiya alohida olib boriladigan klassik tanlov bu yerda ishlamaydi: nomzodlar oqimi, tez qarorlar va tushunarli jarayon kerak. Ommaviy tanlov qanday tuzilganini va ko‘pincha vaqt va odamlar qayerda yo‘qotilishini ko‘rib chiqamiz.

Ommaviy tanlov nima

Ommaviy tanlov – qisqa muddatda bir xil lavozimlarga ko‘p sonli xodimlarni ishga olish. U ko‘pincha quyidagilarga kerak bo‘ladi:

  • kontakt-markazlar va BPO loyihalariga – operatorlar, qo‘llab-quvvatlash mutaxassislari, jumladan chet tillarini biladiganlar;
  • chakana savdoga – sotuvchilar, kassirlar, omborchilar;
  • ishlab chiqarish va logistikaga – ishchilar, haydovchilar, yig‘uvchilar;
  • restoran va mehmonxonalarga – ofitsiantlar, oshpazlar, qabul xizmati xodimlari.

Alohida tanlovdan asosiy farqi – voronka bilan ishlash. Har bir nomzodning mukammalligi emas, balki qancha odam kerakli muddatda ishga chiqishi va sinov muddatidan keyin qolishi muhim.

Jarayon bosqichma-bosqich

1. Nomzod profilini tasvirlang

3–5 ta majburiy mezonni tanlang: masalan, til darajasi, smenali ishlashga tayyorlik, savodli nutq. Qolgan hammasi – qo‘shimcha talablar. Majburiy talablar ro‘yxati qanchalik uzun bo‘lsa, voronka shunchalik tor va qidiruv shunchalik uzoq bo‘ladi.

2. Voronkani hisoblang

Bitta odam ishga chiqishi uchun nechta javob kerakligini aniqlang. Masalan, 10 ta javobdan 4 tasi suhbatga keladi, 2 tasi taklif oladi va 1–2 tasi ishga chiqadi, deylik – unda 30 ta xodimni ishga olish uchun taxminan 150–300 ta javob kerak bo‘ladi. Bu shartli misol: haqiqiy raqamlar lavozim va shartlarga bog‘liq. Hisob tanlangan kanallar va byudjet yetarlimi-yo‘qmi, darhol ko‘rsatadi.

3. Bir nechta kanalni ulang

  • vakansiyalar saytlari;
  • shahar va tuman bo‘yicha Telegram-kanallar va vakansiya chatlari;
  • amaldagi xodimlarning tavsiyalari;
  • kollejlar, oliygohlar va til markazlari – tajribasiz lavozimlar va til loyihalari uchun;
  • agentlikning o‘z nomzodlar bazasi.

Auditoriyangiz haqiqatda bo‘lgan kanallarga tayaning va qaysi biri shunchaki javob beradigan emas, balki ishga chiqadigan odamlarni olib kelishini kuzatib boring.

4. Javob berishni oddiy va tez qiling

Ommaviy tanlovda nomzod bir vaqtning o‘zida bir nechta kompaniyaga javob beradi va birinchi bo‘lib javob berganini tanlaydi. Majburiy rezyume o‘rniga qisqa anketa, Telegram orqali javob va bir sutka ichida qo‘ng‘iroq suhbatgacha yetib keladiganlar ulushini sezilarli oshiradi.

5. Telefon orqali preskrining o‘tkazing

Skript bo‘yicha qisqa qo‘ng‘iroq majburiy mezonlarni tekshiradi: ish jadvali, ish haqi bo‘yicha kutishlar, til darajasi, kerakli sanada ishga chiqishga tayyorlik. Shunda yuzma-yuz uchrashuvlarga faqat haqiqatan mos keladiganlar keladi.

6. Guruhli suhbatlardan foydalaning

Guruhli uchrashuvlar yoki assessment kunlari bir necha soat ichida o‘nlab nomzodlarni baholash imkonini beradi: kompaniya va shartlar haqida gapirib berish, qisqa mashqlar o‘tkazish va kuchlilarni darhol tanlash.

7. Taklifni tez bering

Qarorni suhbat kuni yoki ertasi kuni aytgan ma’qul. Har bir kutish kuni – nomzod boshqa taklifni qabul qilish xavfi. Birinchi ish kuni arafasida eslatma ishga chiqmaydiganlar sonini kamaytiradi.

8. Moslashuvga e’tibor bering

Ommaviy ishga olishda ketishlarning katta qismi dastlabki haftalarga to‘g‘ri keladi. Murabbiy, tushunarli o‘qitish rejasi va birinchi kunlardagi fikr-mulohaza shunchalik qiyinchilik bilan topilgan odamlarni ushlab qolishga yordam beradi.

Qaysi ko‘rsatkichlarni kuzatish kerak

  • Yopish vaqti – vakansiya ochilganidan xodim ishga chiqqunicha necha kun o‘tadi.
  • Bosqichlar bo‘yicha konversiya – voronka nomzodlarni eng ko‘p qayerda yo‘qotadi.
  • Kanallar samaradorligi – ishga chiqadigan va qoladigan odamlar qayerdan keladi.
  • Sinov muddatidan o‘tganlar ulushi – ommaviy ishga olish sifatining asosiy ko‘rsatkichi.

Ko‘p uchraydigan xatolar

  • Oddiy lavozimga juda ko‘p majburiy talablar.
  • Javob yoki suhbatdan keyin nomzodga kech javob berish.
  • Vakansiyadagi shartlar haqiqatdan farq qiladi – odamlar birinchi haftada ketadi.
  • Kanallar hisobi yo‘q, shuning uchun byudjet ishga chiqishlar emas, faqat javoblar bo‘lgan joyga sarflanadi.
  • Moslashuv «keyinga» qoldiriladi.

Til loyihalari uchun ommaviy tanlov

Chet tillari bilan ishlaydigan kontakt-markazlar va BPO loyihalari uchun standart jarayonga preskrining bosqichidayoq til darajasini – og‘zaki va yozma – tekshirish qo‘shiladi. Bunday nomzodlar kamroq, shuning uchun to‘g‘ridan-to‘g‘ri qidiruv, til hamjamiyatlari bilan ishlash va o‘z bazangiz ayniqsa muhim.

Agentlik qanday yordam beradi

Human and Capital chakana savdo, BPO va ishlab chiqarish uchun ommaviy lavozimlarni yopadi: qidiruv kanallari, preskrining, nomzodlarni baholash va ishga chiqqunicha kuzatib borishni o‘z zimmasiga oladi. Agar xodimlarni rasmiylashtirish ham kerak bo‘lsa, biz autstaffingni taklif qilamiz – qonuniy ishga joylashtirish, ish haqi hisobi va hisobotlar.

Batafsil – xodimlarni tanlash sahifasida.

title: Recruitment agency or in-house HR
description: Which one should a company choose?
body:
When a position opens, managers often ask themselves: should we look for an employee on our own or turn to a recruitment agency?

There is no single answer. Both approaches have their advantages, and the choice depends on business goals, the complexity of the vacancy, the timeline and the company's internal resources.

It is important to understand that this is not a competition between in-house HR and an agency. Ideally they become partners working towards a common goal – finding a strong specialist.

Let's look at when each option works best.

When an in-house recruiter is enough

If the company already has an established HR function, most vacancies are filled successfully in-house.

Especially if:

  • standard positions open regularly;
  • the company has a strong employer brand;
  • there are enough applications to choose from;
  • there is an in-house candidate database;
  • the timeline allows hiring without rushing.

An in-house recruiter knows the business, the corporate culture, the managers and the team well. This helps assess candidates more accurately and support them after they start.

In addition, an in-house specialist is often involved not only in hiring but also in onboarding, staff development, training, performance assessment and other HR processes.

When it is worth turning to a recruitment agency

There are situations when the internal team's capacity may not be enough.

For example:

  • a rare specialist is needed;
  • the vacancy must be filled urgently;
  • the company has no recruiter of its own;
  • many vacancies are open at the same time;
  • you need to find a manager or a niche expert;
  • the search must be confidential.

In such cases the agency becomes an additional resource that expands your search capabilities.

How is an agency different from an in-house recruiter?

At first glance the task is the same – to find a suitable candidate.

But the approach is different.

Recruitment agencies work with the labour market every day, fill vacancies in different industries and constantly interact with a large number of specialists.

As a result, they:

  • have a broad candidate database;
  • know the situation on the labour market;
  • understand salary levels;
  • know how to work with passive candidates;
  • use several search methods at once;
  • can quickly scale up when the number of vacancies grows.

An in-house recruiter usually knows the specifics of their company more deeply, but rarely has the opportunity to search across several markets or areas at once.

Cost: what is really cheaper?

Many believe that in-house hiring is always cheaper.

But it is important to take all costs into account.

Keeping an in-house recruiter includes:

  • salary;
  • taxes and mandatory contributions;
  • a workplace;
  • access to job sites;
  • licences for professional services;
  • training;
  • software.

If a company hires irregularly, keeping its own specialist may be less cost-effective than turning to an agency when needed.

On the other hand, for a business with constant mass hiring, a strong in-house team is often the more effective solution.

That is why it is important to assess not only the price of the service but the total cost of the recruitment function.

Who fills vacancies faster?

There is no single answer.

For standard positions an in-house recruiter can work faster thanks to a deep understanding of the business and quick communication with managers.

If you need to find a rare specialist or an executive, an agency often has the advantage thanks to its own candidate database, a developed network of professional contacts and experience in direct search.

Speed depends not only on who does the work but on many other factors:

  • how attractive the employer is;
  • the salary level;
  • the speed of decision-making;
  • the quality of the interview process;
  • the situation on the labour market.

What do successful companies choose?

Practice shows that many companies do not set in-house hiring against external partners.

They use a combined approach.

For example:

  • in-house HR fills mass and regular vacancies;
  • the agency is brought in for complex, urgent or managerial roles;
  • during rapid business growth both teams work in parallel.

This format keeps things flexible and avoids overloading the internal recruitment team.

When cooperation works best

The most successful projects happen when the in-house recruiter and the agency do not compete but share information and act as one team.

For this it is important to:

  • clearly define areas of responsibility;
  • agree on the candidate requirements;
  • give feedback promptly;
  • follow the same standards of communication with candidates;
  • regularly discuss the progress of the search.

This kind of cooperation helps make decisions faster and improves the candidate experience.

In conclusion

The question is not which is better – an in-house recruiter or a recruitment agency. The question is which tool is most effective for a specific task.

If a company hires regularly and has a strong HR team, most vacancies can indeed be filled in-house.

If you need to find a rare specialist, quickly scale up hiring or bring in expertise in a new area, working with a recruitment agency becomes the logical choice.

The most effective approach is not to choose between the two but to use the strengths of each. This is what companies do when they see recruitment as a strategic function that drives business growth, not just a process of filling vacancies.

title: Rekruting agentligi yoki ichki HR
body:
Kompaniyada vakansiya ochilganda rahbarlar ko‘pincha o‘zlariga savol beradi: xodimni o‘z kuchimiz bilan qidiramizmi yoki rekruting agentligiga murojaat qilamizmi?

Bir xil javob yo‘q. Ikkala yondashuvning ham o‘z afzalliklari bor va tanlov biznes vazifalariga, vakansiyaning murakkabligiga, muddatlarga va kompaniyaning ichki resurslariga bog‘liq.

Shuni tushunish muhimki, gap ichki HR va rekruting agentligi o‘rtasidagi raqobat haqida emas. Ideal holatda ular umumiy maqsad – kuchli mutaxassisni topish uchun ishlaydigan hamkorlarga aylanadi.

Qaysi holatda qaysi variant samaraliroq ekanini ko‘rib chiqamiz.

Ichki rekruter yetarli bo‘lgan holatlar

Agar kompaniyada HR funksiyasi allaqachon yo‘lga qo‘yilgan bo‘lsa, ko‘pchilik vakansiyalar o‘z kuchi bilan muvaffaqiyatli yopiladi.

Ayniqsa, agar:

  • muntazam ravishda odatiy lavozimlar ochilsa;
  • kompaniyaning kuchli HR-brendi bo‘lsa;
  • nomzodlarni tanlash uchun javoblar yetarli bo‘lsa;
  • o‘z nomzodlar bazasi bo‘lsa;
  • qidiruv muddati shoshilmasdan tanlov o‘tkazishga imkon bersa.

Ichki rekruter biznesni, korporativ madaniyatni, rahbarlarni va jamoaning xususiyatlarini yaxshi biladi. Bu nomzodlarni aniqroq baholash va ishga chiqqandan keyin ularni kuzatib borishga yordam beradi.

Bundan tashqari, ichki mutaxassis ko‘pincha nafaqat tanlovda, balki xodimlarning moslashuvi, rivojlanishi, o‘qitish, samaradorlikni baholash va boshqa HR jarayonlarida ham ishtirok etadi.

Rekruting agentligiga murojaat qilish kerak bo‘lgan holatlar

Ichki jamoaning imkoniyatlari yetarli bo‘lmasligi mumkin bo‘lgan vaziyatlar bor.

Masalan:

  • noyob mutaxassis kerak;
  • vakansiyani qisqa muddatda yopish zarur;
  • kompaniyaning o‘z rekruteri yo‘q;
  • bir vaqtning o‘zida ko‘p vakansiyalar ochiq;
  • rahbar yoki tor sohadagi ekspertni qidirish kerak;
  • maxfiy tanlov talab qilinadi.

Bunday hollarda agentlik qidiruv imkoniyatlarini kengaytiradigan qo‘shimcha resursga aylanadi.

Agentlik ichki rekruterdan nimasi bilan farq qiladi?

Bir qarashda vazifa bir xil – mos nomzodni topish.

Ammo ishga yondashuv farq qiladi.

Rekruting agentliklari har kuni mehnat bozori bilan ishlaydi, turli sohalarda vakansiyalarni yopadi va doimiy ravishda ko‘plab mutaxassislar bilan muloqot qiladi.

Shu tufayli ular:

  • keng nomzodlar bazasiga ega;
  • mehnat bozoridagi vaziyatni biladi;
  • ish haqi darajasini tushunadi;
  • passiv nomzodlar bilan ishlashni biladi;
  • bir vaqtning o‘zida turli qidiruv usullaridan foydalanadi;
  • vakansiyalar soni ortganda ishni tezda kengaytira oladi.

Ichki rekruter, odatda, o‘z kompaniyasining xususiyatlarini chuqurroq biladi, lekin bir vaqtning o‘zida bir nechta bozor yoki yo‘nalish bo‘yicha qidiruv olib borish imkoniyati kamroq bo‘ladi.

Narx: qaysi biri haqiqatan arzonroq?

Ko‘pchilik ichki tanlov har doim arzonroq tushadi, deb hisoblaydi.

Ammo barcha xarajatlarni hisobga olish muhim.

Ichki rekruterni saqlash quyidagilarni o‘z ichiga oladi:

  • ish haqi;
  • soliqlar va majburiy to‘lovlar;
  • ish joyi;
  • ish saytlariga kirish;
  • professional xizmatlar litsenziyalari;
  • o‘qitish;
  • dasturiy ta’minot.

Agar kompaniya xodimlarni muntazam ishga olmasa, o‘z mutaxassisini saqlash kerak bo‘lganda agentlikka murojaat qilishdan ko‘ra kamroq foydali bo‘lishi mumkin.

Boshqa tomondan, doimiy ommaviy tanlov olib boradigan biznes uchun kuchli ichki jamoa ko‘pincha samaraliroq yechim bo‘ladi.

Shuning uchun faqat xizmat narxini emas, balki tanlov funksiyasiga ketadigan umumiy xarajatlarni ham baholash muhim.

Vakansiyalarni kim tezroq yopadi?

Bir xil javob yo‘q.

Odatiy lavozimlar haqida gap ketsa, ichki rekruter biznesni chuqur tushunishi va rahbarlar bilan tezkor muloqot tufayli tezroq ishlashi mumkin.

Agar noyob mutaxassis yoki rahbarni topish kerak bo‘lsa, agentlik o‘z nomzodlar bazasi, rivojlangan professional aloqalar tarmog‘i va to‘g‘ridan-to‘g‘ri qidiruv tajribasi hisobiga ko‘pincha ustunlikka ega bo‘ladi.

Tezlikka nafaqat ijrochi, balki boshqa ko‘plab omillar ham ta’sir qiladi:

  • ish beruvchining jozibadorligi;
  • ish haqi darajasi;
  • qaror qabul qilish tezligi;
  • suhbat jarayonining sifati;
  • mehnat bozoridagi vaziyat.

Muvaffaqiyatli kompaniyalar nimani tanlaydi?

Amaliyot ko‘rsatishicha, ko‘plab kompaniyalar ichki tanlov va tashqi hamkorlarni bir-biriga qarama-qarshi qo‘ymaydi.

Ular aralash yondashuvdan foydalanadi.

Masalan:

  • ichki HR ommaviy va muntazam vakansiyalarni yopadi;
  • agentlik murakkab, shoshilinch yoki rahbarlik lavozimlariga jalb qilinadi;
  • biznes keskin o‘sganda ikkala jamoa parallel ishlaydi.

Bunday format moslashuvchanlikni saqlash va ichki tanlov bo‘limini ortiqcha yuklamaslik imkonini beradi.

Hamkorlik qachon eng yaxshi ishlaydi

Eng muvaffaqiyatli loyihalar ichki rekruter va agentlik bir-biri bilan raqobatlashmasdan, ma’lumot almashib, yagona jamoa sifatida harakat qilganda yuzaga keladi.

Buning uchun quyidagilar muhim:

  • mas’uliyat sohalarini aniq belgilash;
  • nomzodga qo‘yiladigan talablarni kelishish;
  • fikr-mulohazani tezkor berish;
  • nomzodlar bilan muloqotning yagona standartlariga rioya qilish;
  • qidiruv jarayonini muntazam muhokama qilish.

Bunday hamkorlik qarorlarni tezroq qabul qilishga yordam beradi va nomzodlar tajribasini yaxshilaydi.

Xulosa o‘rniga

Savol qaysi biri yaxshiroq – ichki rekrutermi yoki rekruting agentligimi – degani emas. Savol muayyan vazifa uchun qaysi vosita eng samarali ekanida.

Agar kompaniya muntazam ravishda xodim yollasa va kuchli HR jamoasiga ega bo‘lsa, ko‘pchilik vakansiyalarni haqiqatan ham o‘z kuchi bilan yopish mumkin.

Agar noyob mutaxassisni topish, tanlovni tezda kengaytirish yoki yangi yo‘nalishda ekspertizani jalb qilish kerak bo‘lsa, rekruting agentligi bilan hamkorlik mantiqiy yechimga aylanadi.

Eng samarali yondashuv – ikki variant o‘rtasida tanlash emas, balki har birining kuchli tomonlaridan foydalanish. Rekrutmentni faqat vakansiyalarni yopish jarayoni emas, balki biznes rivojiga ta’sir qiladigan strategik funksiya deb biladigan kompaniyalar aynan shunday qiladi.

Murakkab lavozim bo‘yicha yordam kerakmi? Xodimlarni tanlash va executive search xizmatlarimizni ko‘ring.

title: Competency-based interview
description: What it is and how to use it
body:
A competency-based interview (CBI) is one of the most effective and structured methods of assessing candidates, widely used in modern recruitment.

Put simply, it is an interview that assesses not what a person says about themselves, but how they actually acted in specific work situations in the past.

What are competencies?

Competencies are more than knowledge or experience.

They are a combination of:

  • skills;
  • patterns of behaviour;
  • ways of making decisions;
  • personal qualities that affect work results.

For example:

  • responsibility;
  • leadership;
  • analytical thinking;
  • communication;
  • stress resilience;
  • results orientation.

What is the core idea of a competency-based interview?

The main principle is very simple:

past behaviour = the best predictor of future behaviour

Instead of questions like:

  • “What can you do?”
  • “What skills do you have?”

the interviewer asks:

  • “Tell me about a situation when…”
  • “Give an example of how you…”
  • “What did you do when…”

Sample questions

1. Responsibility

  • Tell me about a time you made a mistake. What did you do?

2. Teamwork

  • Give an example of a conflict in your team and how you resolved it.

3. Stress resilience

  • Tell me about your most difficult project and how you coped with deadline pressure.

4. Decision-making

  • Describe a situation when you had several ways to solve a problem. How did you choose?

Why does this method work better than a regular interview?

A regular interview often looks like this:

  • the candidate describes how things should be;
  • the recruiter gets ideal but abstract answers.

A competency-based interview lets you:

  • move from theory to real cases;
  • see real experience rather than declared skills;
  • assess the candidate's reasoning;
  • understand how they behave under stress.

How is a competency-based interview conducted?

The process usually looks like this:

1. Key competencies are defined

For example:

  • communication;
  • leadership;
  • analytical skills;
  • teamwork.

2. Questions are prepared for each competency

3. A single interview structure is used

All candidates get the same questions.

4. The assessment is recorded on a scale

For example:

  • 1 – weak;
  • 3 – average;
  • 5 – strong.

The STAR method – the basis of the interview

Candidates' answers are most often analysed using the STAR model:

  • S (Situation)
  • T (Task)
  • A (Action)
  • R (Result)

If a candidate describes only the situation without the result, the answer is considered incomplete.

Common candidate mistakes

In this kind of interview candidates often:

  • speak in general phrases (“we worked as a team”);
  • give no specific examples;
  • confuse their own actions with the team's;
  • cannot describe the result;
  • drift into theory instead of practice.

Common recruiter mistakes

The method loses its effectiveness if:

  • general questions are asked without structure;
  • answers are not recorded;
  • the interview turns into an ordinary conversation;
  • no rating scale is used;
  • candidates are not asked the same questions.

Where are competency-based interviews used?

The method is especially effective for:

  • IT and digital roles;
  • management roles;
  • sales;
  • HR and administrative functions;
  • international companies;
  • mass and mid-level recruitment.

Pros of the method

  • high objectivity;
  • less influence of subjective opinion;
  • candidates can be compared;
  • it predicts behaviour at work;
  • a structured assessment process.

Cons of the method

  • it requires preparation;
  • it takes longer than a regular interview;
  • it does not always suit entry-level roles;
  • recruiters need training.

In conclusion

A competency-based interview is a move from intuitive hiring to a systematic assessment of candidates.

Its main value is that it shows not how a person describes themselves, but how they actually act in work situations.

In modern recruitment this approach is becoming the standard for quality hiring, especially where a wrong hire is expensive.

In short: competencies are not words but behaviour. And a competency-based interview is a way to see that behaviour.

Every candidate we present goes through a competency-based assessment. Learn more about our recruitment service.

title: Kompetensiyalar bo‘yicha suhbat
description: Bu nima va undan qanday foydalaniladi
body:
Kompetensiyalar bo‘yicha suhbat (Competency-based interview, CBI) – zamonaviy rekrutmentda faol qo‘llaniladigan nomzodlarni baholashning eng samarali va tuzilmali usullaridan biri.

Oddiy qilib aytganda, bu suhbatda odamning o‘zi haqida nima deyishi emas, balki o‘tmishda muayyan ish vaziyatlarida qanday harakat qilgani baholanadi.

Kompetensiyalar nima?

Kompetensiyalar – shunchaki bilim yoki tajriba emas.

Bu quyidagilar yig‘indisi:

  • ko‘nikmalar;
  • xulq-atvor modellari;
  • qaror qabul qilish usullari;
  • ish natijasiga ta’sir qiladigan shaxsiy fazilatlar.

Masalan:

  • mas’uliyat;
  • yetakchilik;
  • tahliliy fikrlash;
  • muloqot;
  • stressga chidamlilik;
  • natijaga yo‘naltirilganlik.

Kompetensiyalar bo‘yicha suhbatning mohiyati nimada?

Asosiy tamoyil juda oddiy:

o‘tmishdagi xatti-harakat = kelajakdagi xatti-harakatning eng yaxshi bashorati

Quyidagi savollar o‘rniga:

  • «Nimalarni bilasiz?»
  • «Qanday ko‘nikmalaringiz bor?»

quyidagi savollar beriladi:

  • «…bo‘lgan vaziyat haqida gapirib bering»
  • «…qanday qilganingizga misol keltiring»
  • «…bo‘lganda nima qildingiz?»

Savollarga misollar

1. Mas’uliyat haqida

  • Xatoga yo‘l qo‘ygan vaziyatingiz haqida gapirib bering. Nima qildingiz?

2. Jamoada ishlash haqida

  • Jamoadagi nizoga va uni qanday hal qilganingizga misol keltiring.

3. Stressga chidamlilik haqida

  • Eng murakkab loyihangiz va muddatlar bosimini qanday yengganingiz haqida gapirib bering.

4. Qaror qabul qilish haqida

  • Vazifani hal qilishning bir nechta varianti bo‘lgan vaziyatni tasvirlab bering. Qanday tanladingiz?

Nima uchun bu usul oddiy suhbatdan yaxshiroq ishlaydi?

Oddiy suhbat ko‘pincha shunday ko‘rinadi:

  • nomzod «qanday bo‘lishi kerakligi» haqida gapiradi;
  • rekruter ideal, lekin mavhum javoblar oladi.

Kompetensiyalar bo‘yicha suhbat quyidagilarga imkon beradi:

  • nazariyadan haqiqiy keyslarga o‘tish;
  • e’lon qilingan ko‘nikmalarni emas, haqiqiy tajribani ko‘rish;
  • fikrlash mantiqini baholash;
  • stressli vaziyatlardagi xatti-harakatni tushunish.

Kompetensiyalar bo‘yicha suhbat qanday o‘tkaziladi?

Jarayon odatda shunday ko‘rinadi:

1. Asosiy kompetensiyalar belgilanadi

Masalan:

  • muloqot;
  • yetakchilik;
  • tahlil;
  • jamoada ishlash.

2. Har bir kompetensiya uchun savollar tuziladi

3. Suhbatning yagona tuzilmasidan foydalaniladi

Barcha nomzodlarga bir xil savollar beriladi.

4. Baho shkala bo‘yicha qayd etiladi

Masalan:

  • 1 – past daraja;
  • 3 – o‘rtacha;
  • 5 – yuqori.

STAR usuli – suhbatning asosi

Nomzodlarning javoblari ko‘pincha STAR modeli bo‘yicha tahlil qilinadi:

  • S (Situation) – vaziyat
  • T (Task) – vazifa
  • A (Action) – harakatlar
  • R (Result) – natija

Agar nomzod natijasiz faqat vaziyatni aytib bersa, javob to‘liq emas deb hisoblanadi.

Nomzodlarning ko‘p uchraydigan xatolari

Bunday suhbat paytida nomzodlar ko‘pincha:

  • umumiy iboralar bilan gapiradi («biz jamoada ishladik»);
  • aniq misollar keltirmaydi;
  • o‘z harakatlarini jamoa harakatlari bilan adashtiradi;
  • natijani tasvirlab bera olmaydi;
  • amaliyot o‘rniga nazariyaga o‘tib ketadi.

Rekruterlarning ko‘p uchraydigan xatolari

Usul samaradorligini yo‘qotadi, agar:

  • tuzilmasiz umumiy savollar berilsa;
  • javoblar qayd etilmasa;
  • suhbat oddiy gurungga aylansa;
  • baholash shkalasidan foydalanilmasa;
  • barcha nomzodlar uchun bir xil savollar bo‘lmasa.

Kompetensiyalar bo‘yicha suhbat qayerda qo‘llaniladi?

Bu usul ayniqsa quyidagilar uchun samarali:

  • IT va digital lavozimlar;
  • rahbarlik lavozimlari;
  • savdo;
  • HR va ma’muriy funksiyalar;
  • xalqaro kompaniyalar;
  • ommaviy va o‘rta darajadagi tanlov.

Usulning afzalliklari

  • yuqori xolislik;
  • subyektiv fikr ta’sirining kamayishi;
  • nomzodlarni solishtirish imkoniyati;
  • ishdagi xatti-harakatni bashorat qilish;
  • tuzilmali baholash jarayoni.

Usulning kamchiliklari

  • tayyorgarlik talab qiladi;
  • oddiy suhbatdan ko‘proq vaqt oladi;
  • eng boshlang‘ich lavozimlar uchun har doim ham mos kelmaydi;
  • rekruterlarni o‘qitishni talab qiladi.

Xulosa o‘rniga

Kompetensiyalar bo‘yicha suhbat – «intuitiv ishga olish»dan nomzodlarni tizimli baholashga o‘tish.

Uning asosiy qadri shundaki, u odamning o‘zini qanday tasvirlashini emas, balki ish vaziyatlarida haqiqatan qanday harakat qilishini ko‘rish imkonini beradi.

Zamonaviy rekrutmentda aynan shu yondashuv sifatli xodim tanlash standartiga aylanmoqda, ayniqsa ishga olishdagi xato qimmatga tushadigan joylarda.

Qisqasi: kompetensiyalar – so‘zlar emas, xatti-harakat. Kompetensiyalar bo‘yicha suhbat esa shu xatti-harakatni ko‘rish usuli.

Biz taqdim etadigan har bir nomzod kompetensiyalar bo‘yicha baholashdan o‘tadi. Batafsil – xodimlarni tanlash sahifasida.

title: Pre-screening
description: How we save hiring time and improve recruitment quality
body:
When a company opens a vacancy, it seems the hardest part is finding candidates. In practice that is only the beginning.

Imagine a vacancy receives 150 applications. Even if reviewing each CV takes just 3 minutes, the recruiter needs more than 7 hours for the initial review alone. Then they must contact the candidates, run phone interviews and only after that present the most suitable specialists to the manager.

That is why pre-screening is one of the key stages of modern recruitment.

What is pre-screening?

Pre-screening is the initial assessment of a candidate before the main interview.

Its goal is to quickly determine whether the candidate meets the basic requirements of the vacancy and whether to move on to the next stage.

It is important to understand that pre-screening is not a full interview. It is a short check that saves time for both the company and the candidate.

What does pre-screening achieve?

The main goal is not to find the perfect candidate but to rule out obvious mismatches.

During pre-screening the recruiter usually checks:

  • whether the candidate is actively looking for a job;
  • their interest in the vacancy;
  • experience in the required field;
  • key professional skills;
  • foreign language level (if it matters for the role);
  • salary expectations;
  • readiness for the proposed schedule;
  • readiness for business trips or relocation;
  • when they can start.

After such a conversation it becomes clear whether to invite the candidate to a full interview.

Why you should not skip this stage

Sometimes companies try to speed up hiring and go straight to an interview with the manager.

At first glance this looks efficient.

But in practice the manager may spend several hours meeting candidates who:

  • expect a salary well above the budget;
  • are not ready to work in the office;
  • see the offer only as a backup option;
  • lack the required competencies;
  • cannot start on the required date.

As a result, everyone involved loses time.

Pre-screening helps avoid such situations.

What does an experienced recruiter assess?

Beyond the formal criteria, the first conversation can provide valuable information about the candidate.

For example:

  • how interested the person is in the vacancy;
  • how they talk about their experience;
  • how coherently they express their thoughts;
  • what motivates them to consider a change of job;
  • what they expect from a new employer;
  • how realistic their career plans are.

These details help prepare for the main interview and make it more meaningful.

How long should pre-screening take?

A common mistake is to turn pre-screening into a full one-hour interview.

The optimal length is 10–20 minutes.

That is enough to:

  • check the main requirements;
  • answer the candidate's questions;
  • understand the level of mutual interest;
  • decide on the next step.

If the conversation stretches to 40–60 minutes, you are already conducting an interview, not a pre-screening.

How pre-screening helps the business

Well-organised pre-screening helps to:

  • reduce the number of irrelevant interviews;
  • lighten the load on managers;
  • speed up the hiring process;
  • fill vacancies faster;
  • improve the quality of the candidates presented;
  • increase the chance that an offer is accepted.

The effect is especially noticeable in mass recruitment or when hiring for scarce skills, where the speed of decisions is decisive.

How we run pre-screening at Human and Capital

For us pre-screening is not a formal CV check.

Before presenting a candidate to a client, we try to understand not only their professional experience but also their motivation, career expectations and readiness for the proposed conditions.

We always discuss:

  • why the candidate is considering a change of job;
  • which projects interest them;
  • which conditions are non-negotiable for them;
  • whether the vacancy matches their professional expectations;
  • whether they are ready to go through all stages of selection.

This approach lets us send the client not just profiles that match on paper, but candidates who are genuinely interested in the vacancy and ready to move forward.

Pre-screening is respect for time

Good recruitment is not about the number of interviews held, but about the quality of the decisions made.

Every unnecessary stage, every meeting without a result is lost time for the company, the manager and the candidate.

That is why pre-screening should not be seen as extra bureaucracy. It is a tool that makes hiring faster, more transparent and more effective.

In conclusion

With high competition for specialists, hiring speed becomes one of an employer's key advantages. But speed should not come at the expense of quality.

Pre-screening is what strikes the balance between the two. It helps quickly filter out unsuitable candidates, focus on genuinely promising specialists and make the selection process more comfortable for everyone.

Good pre-screening is more than a first call to a candidate. It is the foundation of quality recruitment and one of the most effective ways to save time in hiring.

title: Preskrining
description: Ishga olish vaqtini qanday tejaymiz va tanlov sifatini oshiramiz
body:
Kompaniya vakansiya ochganda eng qiyini nomzodlarni topish bo‘lib tuyuladi. Amalda bu jarayonning boshlanishi xolos.

Tasavvur qiling: vakansiyaga 150 ta javob keldi. Har bir rezyumeni ko‘rib chiqish atigi 3 daqiqa olsa ham, rekruterga faqat dastlabki tahlil uchun 7 soatdan ko‘proq vaqt kerak bo‘ladi. Keyin nomzodlar bilan bog‘lanish, telefon orqali suhbatlar o‘tkazish va shundan keyingina eng mos mutaxassislarni rahbarga taqdim etish kerak.

Aynan shuning uchun preskrining zamonaviy rekrutmentning asosiy bosqichlaridan biri hisoblanadi.

Preskrining nima?

Preskrining (Pre-screening) – asosiy suhbatdan oldin nomzodni dastlabki baholash.

Uning maqsadi – nomzod vakansiyaning asosiy talablariga javob beradimi va tanlovning keyingi bosqichiga o‘tishga arziydimi, buni tezda aniqlash.

Shuni tushunish muhimki, preskrining to‘laqonli suhbat emas. Bu kompaniya va nomzodning o‘zi uchun ham vaqtni tejashga yordam beradigan qisqa tekshiruv bosqichi.

Preskrining qanday vazifalarni hal qiladi?

Asosiy vazifa ideal nomzodni topish emas, balki aniq nomuvofiqliklarni chiqarib tashlash.

Preskrining paytida rekruter odatda quyidagilarni aniqlaydi:

  • ish qidirish dolzarbligini;
  • vakansiyaga qiziqishni;
  • kerakli sohadagi ish tajribasini;
  • asosiy kasbiy ko‘nikmalar mavjudligini;
  • chet tillarini bilish darajasini (agar lavozim uchun muhim bo‘lsa);
  • ish haqi bo‘yicha kutishlarni;
  • taklif qilinayotgan ish jadvaliga tayyorlikni;
  • xizmat safarlari yoki ko‘chib o‘tish imkoniyatini;
  • ishga chiqish muddatlarini.

Bunday suhbatdan keyin nomzodni to‘laqonli suhbatga taklif qilish kerakmi-yo‘qmi, aniq bo‘ladi.

Nima uchun bu bosqichni o‘tkazib yuborish mumkin emas?

Ba’zan kompaniyalar tanlovni tezlashtirishga intilib, darhol rahbar bilan suhbat tashkil qiladi.

Bir qarashda bu samarali yechimdek tuyuladi.

Ammo amalda rahbar bir necha soatini quyidagi nomzodlar bilan uchrashuvlarga sarflashi mumkin:

  • byudjetdan ancha yuqori ish haqi kutayotganlar;
  • ofisda ishlashga tayyor bo‘lmaganlar;
  • taklifni faqat zaxira variant sifatida ko‘rayotganlar;
  • majburiy kompetensiyalarga ega bo‘lmaganlar;
  • kerakli muddatda ishga chiqishga tayyor bo‘lmaganlar.

Natijada jarayonning barcha ishtirokchilari vaqt yo‘qotadi.

Preskrining bunday vaziyatlarning oldini olishga yordam beradi.

Tajribali rekruter nimani baholaydi?

Rasmiy mezonlardan tashqari, birinchi suhbat davomida nomzod haqida qimmatli ma’lumot olish mumkin.

Masalan:

  • odam vakansiyaga qanchalik qiziqqan;
  • o‘z tajribasi haqida qanday gapiradi;
  • fikrlarini qanchalik izchil bayon qiladi;
  • uni ish o‘zgartirishni ko‘rib chiqishga nima undaydi;
  • yangi ish beruvchidan nimalarni kutadi;
  • karyera rejalari qanchalik real.

Bu tafsilotlar asosiy suhbatga yaxshiroq tayyorlanish va uni mazmunliroq qilishga yordam beradi.

Preskrining qancha davom etishi kerak?

Keng tarqalgan xatolardan biri – preskriningni bir soatlik to‘laqonli suhbatga aylantirish.

Optimal davomiylik – 10–20 daqiqa.

Bu vaqt quyidagilar uchun yetarli:

  • asosiy talablarni tekshirish;
  • nomzodning savollariga javob berish;
  • o‘zaro qiziqish darajasini tushunish;
  • keyingi bosqich haqida qaror qabul qilish.

Agar suhbat 40–60 daqiqaga cho‘zilsa, demak siz preskrining emas, balki suhbat o‘tkazyapsiz.

Preskrining biznesga qanday yordam beradi?

To‘g‘ri tashkil etilgan preskrining quyidagilarga imkon beradi:

  • nomuvofiq suhbatlar sonini qisqartirish;
  • rahbarlar yukini kamaytirish;
  • ishga olish jarayonini tezlashtirish;
  • vakansiyalarni tezroq yopish;
  • taqdim etilayotgan nomzodlar sifatini yaxshilash;
  • taklif qabul qilinish ehtimolini oshirish.

Samara ayniqsa ommaviy tanlovda yoki tanqis mutaxassislar bilan ishlashda sezilarli bo‘ladi, bu yerda qaror qabul qilish tezligi hal qiluvchi rol o‘ynaydi.

Human and Capitalda preskriningni qanday o‘tkazamiz

Biz uchun preskrining – rezyumeni rasmiy tekshirish emas.

Nomzodni mijozga taqdim etishdan oldin biz nafaqat uning kasbiy tajribasini, balki motivatsiyasi, karyera kutishlari va taklif qilinayotgan shartlarga tayyorligini ham tushunishga harakat qilamiz.

Biz albatta quyidagilarni muhokama qilamiz:

  • nomzod nima uchun ish o‘zgartirishni ko‘rib chiqmoqda;
  • uni qanday loyihalar qiziqtiradi;
  • qaysi shartlar u uchun muhim;
  • vakansiya uning kasbiy kutishlariga mos keladimi;
  • u tanlovning barcha bosqichlaridan o‘tishga tayyormi.

Bunday yondashuv buyurtmachiga shunchaki rezyume bo‘yicha mos profillarni emas, balki vakansiyaga haqiqatan qiziqqan va oldinga harakat qilishga tayyor nomzodlarni yuborish imkonini beradi.

Preskrining – vaqtga hurmat

Yaxshi rekrutment – o‘tkazilgan suhbatlar soni emas, balki qabul qilingan qarorlar sifati.

Har bir ortiqcha bosqich, natijasiz har bir uchrashuv – kompaniya, rahbar va nomzod uchun yo‘qotilgan vaqt.

Shuning uchun preskriningni qo‘shimcha byurokratiya deb qarash mumkin emas. Bu ishga olish jarayonini tezroq, shaffofroq va samaraliroq qilishga yordam beradigan vosita.

Xulosa o‘rniga

Mutaxassislar uchun raqobat yuqori bo‘lgan sharoitda ishga olish tezligi ish beruvchining asosiy afzalliklaridan biriga aylanadi. Ammo tezlik sifat hisobiga erishilmasligi kerak.

Aynan preskrining bu ikki vazifa o‘rtasida muvozanat topish imkonini beradi. U mos kelmaydigan nomzodlarni tezda saralash, haqiqatan istiqbolli mutaxassislarga e’tibor qaratish va tanlov jarayonini barcha ishtirokchilar uchun qulayroq qilishga yordam beradi.

Yaxshi preskrining – nomzodga shunchaki birinchi qo‘ng‘iroq emas. Bu sifatli rekrutmentning poydevori va ishga olishda vaqtni tejashning eng samarali vositalaridan biri.

Batafsil – xodimlarni tanlash sahifasida.

title: Recruiter KPIs
description: How to tell whether recruitment is working effectively
body:
Recruitment is often judged subjectively: vacancies “are being filled” or “are not”, candidates are “strong” or “weak”, the team “works well” or “slowly”.

But this approach gives no real understanding of how effective the process is. Especially in companies where hiring directly affects business growth.

To manage recruitment, you have to measure it. That is what KPIs are for.

Let's look at the key recruiter performance indicators and how to interpret them correctly.

1. Time to fill

This is one of the basic recruitment metrics.

It shows how much time passes from opening a vacancy to the candidate's first day at work.

Why it matters:

  • it reflects the recruiter's speed;
  • it shows how efficient the approval process is;
  • it depends on the market and the employer;
  • it directly affects the company's business processes.

But it is important to understand that a long time to fill does not always mean poor recruiter performance. Sometimes it is the result of inflated requirements or a shortage of specialists on the market.

2. Time to hire – from first contact to offer

This KPI reflects the recruiter's work more precisely.

It shows how quickly a candidate goes through the path:

first contact → interview → offer.

If this figure is high, the reasons may be:

  • slow approval processes;
  • a long chain of interviews;
  • weak communication with candidates;
  • an unstructured hiring process.

3. Offer acceptance rate

This metric shows how willing candidates are to accept the company's offers.

If offers are often declined, it signals possible problems:

  • an uncompetitive salary;
  • a drawn-out hiring process;
  • a weak employer brand;
  • poor communication with the candidate;
  • mismatched expectations.

A high rate means the recruiter not only finds candidates but also “sells” the vacancy well.

4. Quality of hire

One of the most difficult but most important KPIs.

It shows how successfully the new employee performs after starting.

It is assessed through:

  • performance in the role;
  • passing probation;
  • the manager's evaluation;
  • engagement at work;
  • turnover.

If an employee leaves quickly or cannot cope with the tasks, it may point to problems at the selection stage.

5. Cost per hire

This KPI shows how much the company spends to fill one vacancy.

The calculation may include:

  • the recruiter's salary;
  • the cost of job postings;
  • access to CV databases;
  • agency services;
  • managers' time;
  • sourcing tools.

It is important to take into account not only direct but also indirect costs.

6. Source of hire

This metric shows which channels bring the best candidates.

For example:

  • LinkedIn;
  • employee referrals;
  • job sites;
  • Telegram;
  • the candidate database;
  • direct search.

If most high-quality candidates come from one channel, it is worth investing more in it.

7. Conversion rate across selection stages

This KPI shows how effectively the hiring funnel works.

The stages usually analysed are:

  • application → screening;
  • screening → interview;
  • interview → offer;
  • offer → start.

If there is a sharp drop in candidates at some stage, that is where the problem is.

8. Retention rate

Although this metric is often attributed to HR in general, it is directly linked to recruitment.

If employees often leave within the first 3–6 months, it signals:

  • the wrong hire;
  • a weak assessment of motivation;
  • mistakes at the interview stage;
  • mismatched expectations.

Good recruitment does not end with an offer – it ends with successful onboarding.

9. Hiring manager satisfaction

One of the most underrated KPIs.

It shows how satisfied managers are with the recruiter's work.

It is assessed through:

  • the quality of candidates;
  • the speed of filling vacancies;
  • communication;
  • understanding of the requirements;
  • transparency of the process.

Even if the speed metrics are good, low hiring manager satisfaction points to problems with the quality of selection.

10. Candidate experience

Modern recruitment is increasingly focused on the candidate experience.

What is assessed:

  • how comfortable the process is;
  • how quickly feedback is given;
  • whether communication is clear;
  • how candidates rate the interviews.

A poor experience can not only spoil a hire but also affect the company's employer brand.

Why KPIs should not be viewed in isolation

The main mistake is to judge a recruiter by a single metric.

For example:

  • fast hiring ≠ quality hiring;
  • low cost ≠ a good result;
  • a large number of applications ≠ successful recruitment.

Recruitment effectiveness is always multidimensional.

What a healthy KPI system looks like

In mature companies recruiter KPIs are a balance of:

  • speed (time to hire);
  • quality (quality of hire);
  • efficiency (conversion rate);
  • client satisfaction (hiring manager satisfaction);
  • cost (cost per hire).

Only together do they give a real picture.

In conclusion

Recruitment KPIs are not a control tool but a management tool.

They help you understand:

  • where candidates are lost;
  • why vacancies are filled slowly;
  • which channels work better;
  • how good the hires are;
  • where the process needs improvement.

Good recruitment is not only about filled vacancies but about predictable results.

KPIs are what turn recruitment from a chaotic process into a managed system that consistently provides the business with the right people.

title: Rekruter KPI ko‘rsatkichlari
description: Rekruting samarali ishlayotganini qanday tushunish mumkin
body:
Rekruting ko‘pincha subyektiv baholanadi: vakansiyalar «yopilyapti» yoki «yopilmayapti», nomzodlar «kuchli» yoki «kuchsiz», «yaxshi ishlayapti» yoki «sekin».

Ammo bunday yondashuv jarayon samaradorligi haqida haqiqiy tasavvur bermaydi. Ayniqsa xodimlarni tanlash biznes o‘sishiga bevosita ta’sir qiladigan kompaniyalarda.

Rekrutingni boshqarish uchun uni o‘lchash kerak. KPI aynan shu uchun mavjud.

Rekruter samaradorligining asosiy ko‘rsatkichlarini va ularni qanday to‘g‘ri talqin qilishni ko‘rib chiqamiz.

1. Time to Fill – vakansiyani yopish vaqti

Bu rekrutmentdagi asosiy ko‘rsatkichlardan biri.

U vakansiya ochilgan paytdan nomzod ishga chiqqunicha qancha vaqt o‘tishini ko‘rsatadi.

Nima uchun bu muhim:

  • rekruterning ish tezligini aks ettiradi;
  • kelishuv jarayonining samaradorligini ko‘rsatadi;
  • bozor va ish beruvchi sifatiga bog‘liq;
  • kompaniyaning biznes jarayonlariga bevosita ta’sir qiladi.

Ammo shuni tushunish muhim: yopishning uzoq muddati har doim ham rekruterning yomon ishlashini anglatmaydi. Ba’zan bu oshirib yuborilgan talablar yoki bozorda mutaxassislar tanqisligining natijasi.

2. Time to Hire – birinchi aloqadan taklifgacha bo‘lgan vaqt

Bu KPI rekruter ishini aniqroq aks ettiradi.

U nomzod quyidagi yo‘lni qanchalik tez bosib o‘tishini ko‘rsatadi:

birinchi aloqa → suhbat → taklif.

Agar bu ko‘rsatkich yuqori bo‘lsa, sabablari quyidagilar bo‘lishi mumkin:

  • sekin kelishuv jarayonlari;
  • suhbatlarning uzun zanjiri;
  • nomzodlar bilan zaif muloqot;
  • tuzilmasiz ishga olish jarayoni.

3. Offer Acceptance Rate – takliflarni qabul qilish foizi

Bu ko‘rsatkich nomzodlar kompaniya takliflarini qabul qilishga qanchalik tayyor ekanini ko‘rsatadi.

Agar takliflar tez-tez rad etilsa, bu ehtimoliy muammolar haqida signal:

  • raqobatbardosh bo‘lmagan ish haqi;
  • cho‘zilib ketgan ishga olish jarayoni;
  • zaif HR-brend;
  • nomzod bilan muvaffaqiyatsiz muloqot;
  • kutishlarning mos kelmasligi.

Yuqori ko‘rsatkich rekruter nafaqat nomzodlarni topishini, balki vakansiyani to‘g‘ri «sotishini» ham anglatadi.

4. Quality of Hire – ishga olish sifati

Eng murakkab, lekin eng muhim KPIlardan biri.

U ishga olingan xodim ishga chiqqandan keyin qanchalik muvaffaqiyatli ishlashini ko‘rsatadi.

Quyidagilar orqali baholanadi:

  • lavozimdagi natijadorlik;
  • sinov muddatidan o‘tish;
  • rahbarning bahosi;
  • ishga jalb qilinganlik;
  • kadrlar qo‘nimsizligi.

Agar xodim tez ketsa yoki vazifalarni uddalay olmasa, bu tanlov bosqichidagi muammolar haqida dalolat berishi mumkin.

5. Cost per Hire – ishga olish qiymati

Bu KPI kompaniya bitta vakansiyani yopishga qancha sarflashini ko‘rsatadi.

Hisobga quyidagilar kirishi mumkin:

  • rekruterning ish haqi;
  • vakansiyalarni joylashtirish narxi;
  • rezyume bazalariga kirish;
  • agentlik xizmatlari;
  • rahbarlarning vaqti;
  • qidiruv vositalari.

Nafaqat to‘g‘ridan-to‘g‘ri, balki bilvosita xarajatlarni ham hisobga olish muhim.

6. Source of Hire – qidiruv kanallari samaradorligi

Bu ko‘rsatkich qaysi kanallar eng yaxshi nomzodlarni olib kelishini tushunishga yordam beradi.

Masalan:

  • LinkedIn;
  • xodimlar tavsiyalari;
  • ish saytlari;
  • Telegram;
  • nomzodlar bazasi;
  • to‘g‘ridan-to‘g‘ri qidiruv.

Agar sifatli nomzodlarning ko‘pchiligi bitta kanaldan kelsa, uni kuchaytirish kerak.

7. Conversion Rate – tanlov bosqichlaridagi konversiya

Bu KPI ishga olish voronkasi qanchalik samarali ishlashini ko‘rsatadi.

Odatda quyidagilar tahlil qilinadi:

  • javob → skrining;
  • skrining → suhbat;
  • suhbat → taklif;
  • taklif → ishga chiqish.

Agar qaysidir bosqichda nomzodlar keskin «tushib ketsa», muammo aynan o‘sha yerda.

8. Retention Rate – xodimlarni ushlab qolish

Bu ko‘rsatkich ko‘pincha umuman HRga taalluqli deb hisoblansa-da, u rekruting bilan bevosita bog‘liq.

Agar xodimlar dastlabki 3–6 oy ichida tez-tez ishdan ketsa, bu quyidagilar haqida signal:

  • noto‘g‘ri tanlov;
  • motivatsiyaning zaif baholanishi;
  • suhbat bosqichidagi xatolar;
  • kutishlarning mos kelmasligi.

Yaxshi rekruting taklif bilan tugamaydi – u muvaffaqiyatli moslashuv bilan tugaydi.

9. Hiring Manager Satisfaction – buyurtmachining qoniqishi

Eng kam baholanadigan KPIlardan biri.

U rahbarlar rekruter ishidan qanchalik mamnun ekanini ko‘rsatadi.

Quyidagilar orqali baholanadi:

  • nomzodlar sifati;
  • vakansiyalarni yopish tezligi;
  • muloqot;
  • talablarni tushunish;
  • jarayon shaffofligi.

Hatto tezlik ko‘rsatkichlari yaxshi bo‘lsa ham, buyurtmachining past qoniqishi tanlov sifatidagi muammolardan dalolat beradi.

10. Candidate Experience – nomzod tajribasi

Zamonaviy rekruting tobora ko‘proq nomzod tajribasiga yo‘naltirilmoqda.

Baholanadi:

  • jarayon qanchalik qulay o‘tadi;
  • fikr-mulohaza qanchalik tez beriladi;
  • muloqot tushunarlimi;
  • nomzodlar suhbatlarni qanday baholaydi.

Yomon tajriba nafaqat ishga olishni buzishi, balki kompaniyaning HR-brendiga ham ta’sir qilishi mumkin.

Nima uchun KPIlarni alohida ko‘rib chiqish mumkin emas

Asosiy xato – rekruterni bitta ko‘rsatkich bo‘yicha baholash.

Masalan:

  • tez ishga olish ≠ sifatli ishga olish;
  • past narx ≠ yaxshi natija;
  • ko‘p javoblar ≠ muvaffaqiyatli tanlov.

Rekrutment samaradorligi har doim ko‘p o‘lchovli.

Sog‘lom KPI tizimi qanday ko‘rinadi

Yetuk kompaniyalarda rekruter KPIlari quyidagilar muvozanatidir:

  • tezlik (Time to Hire);
  • sifat (Quality of Hire);
  • samaradorlik (Conversion Rate);
  • mijoz qoniqishi (Hiring Manager Satisfaction);
  • narx (Cost per Hire).

Faqat birgalikda ular haqiqiy manzarani beradi.

Xulosa o‘rniga

Rekrutmentdagi KPI – nazorat vositasi emas, balki boshqaruv vositasi.

Ular quyidagilarni tushunishga yordam beradi:

  • nomzodlar qayerda yo‘qotilmoqda;
  • nima uchun vakansiyalar sekin yopilmoqda;
  • qaysi kanallar yaxshiroq ishlaydi;
  • ishga olish qanchalik sifatli;
  • jarayonni qayerda yaxshilash kerak.

Yaxshi rekruting faqat «yopilgan vakansiyalar» haqida emas, balki natijaning oldindan aytib bo‘ladiganligi haqida hamdir.

Aynan KPIlar rekrutmentni tartibsiz jarayondan biznesni barqaror ravishda kerakli odamlar bilan ta’minlaydigan boshqariladigan tizimga aylantirish imkonini beradi.

Batafsil – xodimlarni tanlash sahifasida.

title: Найм сотрудников в Узбекистане для иностранной компании
description: Практическое руководство для иностранных компаний, которые создают команду в Ташкенте
body:
Всё больше международных компаний рассматривают Узбекистан как место для создания команд – от поддержки клиентов и контакт-центров до IT, финансов и бэк-офиса. Специалисты здесь есть, но найм из-за рубежа вызывает практические вопросы: как оформить людей законно, где искать кандидатов и как вести процесс без местного HR-отдела. В этом руководстве – основные варианты и самые важные шаги.

Три способа нанимать в Узбекистане

1. Открыть местное юрлицо и нанимать напрямую

Со своим юрлицом вы оформляете сотрудников в штат и сами или через местных партнёров ведёте кадровый учёт, бухгалтерию и отчётность. Это оправдано для долгосрочной работы с большой командой, но открытие и содержание юрлица требует времени и постоянного администрирования.

2. Аутстаффинг через местного провайдера

Провайдер становится официальным работодателем: заключает трудовые договоры, начисляет зарплату, ведёт кадровый учёт и отчётность по трудовому законодательству Узбекистана. Сотрудники работают на ваших задачах и под вашим руководством. Это самый быстрый способ начать с небольшой или средней командой, протестировать рынок или масштабировать проект без открытия юрлица. Ту же модель часто называют Employer of Record.

3. Независимые подрядчики

Некоторые компании привлекают специалистов как подрядчиков. Это может работать для коротких проектов с чётким объёмом, но не заменяет трудоустройство, если люди работают на вас полный день. Прежде чем выбрать этот путь, проверьте правовые последствия для вашего случая у местного юриста.

Каким бывает рынок специалистов

Ташкент – главный центр профессиональных кадров, с сильными пулами в клиентском сервисе, IT, финансах и продажах. Многие специалисты говорят на русском и узбекском, а уровень английского растёт среди молодых профессионалов. Кандидаты на позиции с немецким, французским, корейским, арабским, турецким и другими языками есть, но их меньше, и поиск требует больше усилий.

IT- и BPO-компании могут воспользоваться IT Park – национальным технопарком с льготным правовым и налоговым режимом для резидентов. Применим ли он к вашему проекту, зависит от вида деятельности.

Как вести процесс найма

Точно опишите позицию

Зафиксируйте обязанности, обязательные требования, уровень языка, рабочие часы и часовой пояс. Если команда будет работать с клиентами в Европе или США, сразу укажите график смен – он сильно влияет на то, кто откликнется.

Сверьте зарплату с местным рынком

Зарплатные ожидания в Узбекистане отличаются от вашего рынка и сильно зависят от позиции и языка. Согласуйте вилку до начала поиска и будьте готовы скорректировать её, когда увидите первых кандидатов. Привлекательное по местным меркам, чётко сформулированное и вовремя выплачиваемое предложение – один из самых сильных аргументов при найме.

Используйте местные каналы

Сайты вакансий, Telegram-каналы и профессиональные сообщества – там большинство кандидатов ищет работу. Опытные и узкие специалисты обычно не ищут активно, поэтому важны прямой поиск и рекомендации. Местный рекрутер знает эти каналы и выходит на кандидатов гораздо быстрее, чем HR-команда из-за рубежа.

Проверяйте навыки и язык заранее

Проверяйте уровень языка и ключевые навыки на этапе прескрининга, до встречи кандидатов с вашими руководителями. Для позиций, связанных с клиентами, короткий устный и письменный языковой тест экономит много времени на собеседованиях.

Действуйте быстро и планируйте адаптацию

У сильных кандидатов часто несколько предложений. Сократите число этапов собеседований, быстро давайте обратную связь и подготовьте понятный план адаптации – техника, доступы, наставник и обучение в первые недели.

Частые ошибки

  • Копировать описание вакансии и уровень зарплат из другой страны без адаптации к местному рынку.
  • Слишком много этапов собеседований с долгими паузами между ними.
  • Недооценивать усилия, нужные для редких языковых сочетаний.
  • Выбирать модель трудоустройства, не проверив правовую сторону для своего случая.
  • Откладывать адаптацию и повседневное сопровождение на последний момент.

Чем поможет Human and Capital

Human and Capital – HR-компания в Ташкенте, работающая с местными и международными компаниями. Мы подбираем специалистов и руководителей, собираем команды со знанием языков для BPO и контакт-центров и предоставляем аутстаффинг: официальное оформление, расчёт зарплаты и отчётность для сотрудников, которые работают на ваших задачах. Каждый проект подбора включает одну бесплатную замену в оговорённый срок, бесплатный пробный день кандидата и возврат предоплаты, если в согласованный срок мы не представим минимум трёх подходящих кандидатов.

Подробнее – на страницах HR-услуги в Узбекистане и аутстаффинг.

title: Xorijiy kompaniya uchun O‘zbekistonda xodim yollash
description: Toshkentda jamoa tuzayotgan xorijiy kompaniyalar uchun amaliy qo‘llanma
body:
Tobora ko‘proq xalqaro kompaniyalar O‘zbekistonni jamoa tuzish uchun joy sifatida ko‘rib chiqmoqda – mijozlarni qo‘llab-quvvatlash va kontakt-markazlardan tortib IT, moliya va bek-ofis funksiyalarigacha. Mutaxassislar bor, lekin xorijdan turib ishga olish amaliy savollarni tug‘diradi: odamlarni qanday qonuniy rasmiylashtirish, nomzodlarni qayerdan topish va mahalliy HR jamoasisiz jarayonni qanday olib borish. Ushbu qo‘llanmada asosiy variantlar va eng muhim qadamlar ko‘rib chiqilgan.

O‘zbekistonda xodim yollashning uch usuli

1. Mahalliy yuridik shaxs ochib, to‘g‘ridan-to‘g‘ri ishga olish

O‘z yuridik shaxsingiz bilan siz xodimlarni shtatga olasiz va kadrlar hisobi, buxgalteriya va hisobotlarni o‘zingiz yoki mahalliy hamkorlar orqali yuritasiz. Bu katta jamoa bilan uzoq muddatli ish uchun o‘zini oqlaydi, ammo yuridik shaxsni ochish va yuritish vaqt va doimiy ma’muriy ishni talab qiladi.

2. Mahalliy provayder orqali autstaffing

Provayder rasmiy ish beruvchiga aylanadi: mehnat shartnomalarini tuzadi, ish haqini hisoblaydi, O‘zbekiston mehnat qonunchiligiga muvofiq kadrlar hisobi va hisobotlarni yuritadi. Xodimlar sizning vazifalaringiz ustida va sizning rahbarligingizda ishlaydi. Bu kichik yoki o‘rta jamoa bilan boshlash, bozorni sinab ko‘rish yoki yuridik shaxs ochmasdan loyihani kengaytirishning eng tez yo‘li. Bu model ko‘pincha Employer of Record deb ham ataladi.

3. Mustaqil pudratchilar

Ba’zi kompaniyalar mutaxassislarni pudratchi sifatida jalb qiladi. Bu qisqa va aniq belgilangan loyihalar uchun ishlashi mumkin, ammo odamlar siz uchun to‘liq kun ishlaganda mehnat shartnomasi o‘rnini bosmaydi. Bu yo‘lni tanlashdan oldin o‘z holatingiz uchun huquqiy oqibatlarni mahalliy yurist bilan tekshiring.

Mutaxassislar bozori qanday

Toshkent – professional kadrlarning asosiy markazi bo‘lib, mijozlarga xizmat ko‘rsatish, IT, moliya va savdo sohalarida kuchli kadrlar zaxirasi mavjud. Ko‘plab mutaxassislar rus va o‘zbek tillarida gaplashadi, yosh mutaxassislar orasida ingliz tilini bilish darajasi o‘sib bormoqda. Nemis, fransuz, koreys, arab, turk va boshqa tillar talab qilinadigan lavozimlar uchun nomzodlar bor, lekin ular kamroq va qidiruv ko‘proq kuch talab qiladi.

IT va BPO kompaniyalari rezidentlar uchun imtiyozli huquqiy va soliq rejimini taklif qiladigan milliy texnologik park – IT Parkdan foydalanishi mumkin. U loyihangizga taalluqli bo‘ladimi, faoliyat turiga bog‘liq.

Ishga olish jarayonini qanday olib borish kerak

Lavozimni aniq tasvirlang

Vazifalar, majburiy talablar, til darajasi, ish soatlari va vaqt mintaqasini yozib qo‘ying. Agar jamoa Yevropa yoki AQShdagi mijozlar bilan ishlasa, smena jadvalini boshidanoq ko‘rsating – bu kimlar javob berishiga kuchli ta’sir qiladi.

Ish haqini mahalliy bozor bilan solishtiring

O‘zbekistondagi ish haqi kutishlari sizning bozoringizdan farq qiladi va lavozim hamda tilga qarab katta farq qiladi. Qidiruv boshlanishidan oldin oraliqni kelishib oling va birinchi nomzodlarni ko‘rganingizda uni moslashtirishga tayyor bo‘ling. Mahalliy mezonlar bo‘yicha jozibador, aniq ifodalangan va o‘z vaqtida to‘lanadigan taklif – ishga olishdagi eng kuchli dalillardan biri.

Mahalliy kanallardan foydalaning

Vakansiyalar saytlari, Telegram-kanallar va kasbiy hamjamiyatlar – nomzodlarning ko‘pchiligi ish qidiradigan joylar. Tajribali va tor soha mutaxassislari odatda faol ish qidirmaydi, shuning uchun to‘g‘ridan-to‘g‘ri qidiruv va tavsiyalar muhim. Mahalliy rekruter bu kanallarni biladi va nomzodlarga xorijdagi HR jamoasidan ancha tezroq chiqadi.

Ko‘nikma va tilni oldindan tekshiring

Til darajasi va asosiy ko‘nikmalarni preskrining bosqichida, nomzodlar rahbarlaringiz bilan uchrashguncha tekshiring. Mijozlar bilan ishlaydigan lavozimlar uchun qisqa og‘zaki va yozma til testi suhbatlarda ko‘p vaqtni tejaydi.

Tez harakat qiling va moslashuvni rejalashtiring

Kuchli nomzodlarda ko‘pincha bir nechta taklif bo‘ladi. Suhbat bosqichlari sonini qisqartiring, fikr-mulohazani tez bering va tushunarli moslashuv rejasini tayyorlang – texnika, kirish huquqlari, murabbiy va dastlabki haftalardagi o‘qitish.

Ko‘p uchraydigan xatolar

  • Vakansiya tavsifi va ish haqi darajasini boshqa mamlakatdan mahalliy bozorga moslashtirmasdan ko‘chirish.
  • Suhbat bosqichlarining juda ko‘pligi va ular orasidagi uzoq tanaffuslar.
  • Noyob til birikmalari uchun kerak bo‘ladigan kuchni yetarlicha baholamaslik.
  • O‘z holati uchun huquqiy tomonni tekshirmasdan ishga joylashtirish modelini tanlash.
  • Moslashuv va kundalik yordamni oxirgi daqiqaga qoldirish.

Human and Capital qanday yordam beradi

Human and Capital – mahalliy va xalqaro kompaniyalar bilan ishlaydigan Toshkentdagi HR kompaniya. Biz mutaxassis va rahbarlarni tanlaymiz, BPO va kontakt-markazlar uchun til biladigan jamoalar tuzamiz va autstaffing xizmatini ko‘rsatamiz: sizning vazifalaringiz ustida ishlaydigan xodimlarni rasmiylashtirish, ish haqi hisobi va hisobotlar. Har bir tanlash loyihasi kelishilgan muddatda bir marta bepul almashtirish, nomzodning bepul sinov kuni va kelishilgan muddatda kamida uchta mos nomzod taqdim etilmasa, oldindan to‘lovni qaytarishni o‘z ichiga oladi.

Batafsil – O‘zbekistonda HR xizmatlari va autstaffing sahifalarida.
